recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no core follow-up is needed unless a future PA decision changes HealthcareService.extraDetails again.
issue_request: FHIR-17648 asked to change HealthcareService.extraDetails from string to markdown to allow formatted longer service details; Jira is Published/Persuasive for Patient Administration.
initial_application: Commit bd89a75a69 on 2018-10-28 explicitly included GF#17648 and changed the old HealthcareService spreadsheet extraDetails row from string to markdown; the 2021 source migration preserved that datatype in structuredefinition-HealthcareService.xml.
additional_context: HealthcareService is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition source and FHIR model-definition library both show extraDetails as markdown/FHIR.markdown. The QUICK model-definition example lists System.String, but that model has no markdown primitive and does not override the FHIR conformance datatype. The linked Zulip thread supports the original markdown request, and exact issue-key community searches found no conflicting later evidence.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The combined branch received an empty no-change audit commit documenting that current core source already satisfies the published Jira decision.
